title: Following Two-Step Instructions
introduction: Understand and carry out short sequences of instructions.
definition: Understand and carry out short sequences of instructions.
rules: Listen to the order of the actions.
First, next and then help show the sequence.

examples.question: Partner reads: Stand up, then clap. What comes first?
steps: The first action comes before then.

examples.question: Partner reads: Open your book and point to the title. What comes last?

exercises.question: Partner reads: Stand up, then clap. What comes first?
exercises.solution: The first action comes before then.

exercises.question: Partner reads: Open your book and point to the title. What comes last?
Partner reads: Draw a circle, then colour it blue. Which colour?
exercises.solution: The colour is named in the second instruction.

exercises.question: Partner reads: Pick up the ruler and put it on the desk. Where should it go?
exercises.solution: The last phrase gives the destination.

exercises.question: Partner reads: First wash your hands. Next dry them. What comes next after washing?
What do you say if you need to hear an instruction again? (Please repeat or Goodbye)
exercises.solution: A polite request to repeat helps you understand.

summary: Understand and carry out short sequences of instructions. Listen to the order of the actions.
